title.en: How much? How many? A few, a little
title.de: Wie viel? how much, how many, a few
title.sl: Koliko? how much, how many, a few
title.it: Quanto? how much, how many, a few

goal.sl: Vprašaš how much in how many, poveš veliko z a lot of, ne veliko z much in many ter malo z a few in a little, in vprašaš po ceni.
goal.de: Du fragst how much und how many, sagst viel mit a lot of, nicht viel mit much und many, wenig mit a few und a little, und fragst nach dem Preis.
goal.it: Chiedi how much e how many, dici tanto con a lot of, non molto con much e many, poco con a few e a little, e chiedi il prezzo.
goal.en: You can ask how much and how many, say a lot with a lot of, not a lot with much and many, a small amount with a few and a little, and ask a price.

say.sl: **How many** (koliko) vpraša po tem, kar šteješ, z množino: **How many sheep has Jack got?** (Koliko ovc ima Jack?) **How much** (koliko) vpraša po tem, česar ne šteješ: **How much milk is there?** (Koliko mleka je?) Slovenščina ima za oboje eno besedo, angleščina dve.
say.de: **How many** (wie viele) fragt nach Zählbarem, mit dem Plural: **How many sheep has Jack got?** (Wie viele Schafe hat Jack?) **How much** (wie viel) fragt nach Unzählbarem: **How much milk is there?** (Wie viel Milch ist da?)
say.it: **How many** (quanti, quante) chiede ciò che si conta, con il plurale: **How many sheep has Jack got?** (Quante pecore ha Jack?) **How much** (quanto, quanta) chiede ciò che non si conta: **How much milk is there?** (Quanto latte c'è?)
say.en: **How many** asks about what you can count, with a plural: **How many sheep has Jack got?** (never *How much sheep has Jack got?*) **How much** asks about what you can't: **How much milk is there?**

examples.en: How many sheep has Jack got?
How many eggs did Poppy find?
examples.de: Wie viele Eier hat Poppy gefunden?

say.sl: **a lot of** (veliko) gre z obojim, v trdilnem stavku: **Jack has got a lot of sheep.** (Jack ima veliko ovc.) **There's a lot of hay in the barn.** (V skednju je veliko sena.) **lots of** je isto. Ne pozabi **of**, nikoli *a lot sheep*. Sam: **How much honey? — A lot.** (Koliko medu? — Veliko.)
say.de: **a lot of** (viel, viele) geht mit beidem, im bejahten Satz: **Jack has got a lot of sheep.** (Jack hat viele Schafe.) **There's a lot of hay in the barn.** (In der Scheune ist viel Heu.) **lots of** ist dasselbe. Vergiss **of** nicht, nie *a lot sheep*. Allein: **How much honey? — A lot.** (Wie viel Honig? — Viel.)
say.it: **a lot of** (molto, tanti) va con tutti e due, nelle frasi affermative: **Jack has got a lot of sheep.** (Jack ha tante pecore.) **There's a lot of hay in the barn.** (Nel fienile c'è tanto fieno.) **lots of** è lo stesso. Non dimenticare **of**, mai *a lot sheep*. Da solo: **How much honey? — A lot.** (Quanto miele? — Tanto.)
say.en: **a lot of** goes with both, in a yes sentence: **Jack has got a lot of sheep.** **There's a lot of hay in the barn.** **lots of** is the same. Don't forget **of**: **a lot of sheep** (never *a lot sheep*). Alone: **How much honey? — A lot.**

There's a lot of hay in the barn.
examples.de: In der Scheune ist viel Heu.

examples.de: Wie viel Honig hat Arthur? — Viel.

say.sl: V zanikanem stavku in vprašanju sta **many** in **much** (veliko): **There aren't many walkers today.** (Danes ni veliko pohodnikov.) **We haven't got much time.** (Nimamo veliko časa.) **Is there much snow on the fell?** (Je na hribu veliko snega?) V trdilnem stavku reci **a lot of**: **We've got a lot of time.**, nikoli *We've got much time.*
say.de: Im verneinten Satz und in der Frage stehen **many** und **much** (viele, viel): **There aren't many walkers today.** (Heute sind nicht viele Wanderer da.) **We haven't got much time.** (Wir haben nicht viel Zeit.) **Is there much snow on the fell?** (Liegt viel Schnee am Berg?) Im bejahten Satz sag **a lot of**: **We've got a lot of time.**, nie *We've got much time.*
say.it: Nelle frasi negative e nelle domande si usano **many** e **much** (molti, molto): **There aren't many walkers today.** (Oggi non ci sono molti escursionisti.) **We haven't got much time.** (Non abbiamo molto tempo.) **Is there much snow on the fell?** (C'è molta neve sul monte?) Nelle frasi affermative di' **a lot of**: **We've got a lot of time.**, mai *We've got much time.*
say.en: In a no sentence and a question it's **many** and **much**: **There aren't many walkers today.** **We haven't got much time.** **Is there much snow on the fell?** In a yes sentence say **a lot of**: **We've got a lot of time.** (never *We've got much time.*) It's right in a no sentence too: **We haven't got a lot of time.**

examples.de: Heute sind nicht viele Wanderer da.
examples.it: Oggi non ci sono molti escursionisti.

say.sl: Majhna količina: **a few** (nekaj, par) pri tem, kar šteješ, **a little** (malo) pri tem, česar ne: **a few eggs** (nekaj jajc), **a few walkers** (par pohodnikov); **a little milk** (malo mleka), **a little sugar** (malo sladkorja). **a bit of** (malo) je vsakdanja beseda za **a little**: **a bit of cheese** (malo sira).
say.de: Eine kleine Menge: **a few** (ein paar) bei Zählbarem, **a little** (ein wenig) bei Unzählbarem: **a few eggs** (ein paar Eier), **a few walkers** (ein paar Wanderer); **a little milk** (ein wenig Milch), **a little sugar** (ein wenig Zucker). **a bit of** (ein bisschen) sagt man im Alltag für **a little**: **a bit of cheese** (ein bisschen Käse).
say.it: Una piccola quantità: **a few** (alcuni, qualche) con ciò che si conta, **a little** (un po' di) con ciò che non si conta: **a few eggs** (qualche uovo), **a few walkers** (alcuni escursionisti); **a little milk** (un po' di latte), **a little sugar** (un po' di zucchero). **a bit of** (un po' di) è la parola di ogni giorno per **a little**: **a bit of cheese** (un po' di formaggio).
say.en: A small amount: **a few** with what you can count, **a little** with what you can't: **a few eggs**, **a few walkers**; **a little milk**, **a little sugar** (never *a few sugar*). **a bit of** is the everyday word for **a little**: **a bit of cheese**.

say.sl: Kratki odgovori: **How many? — A lot. Not many. A few.** **How much? — A lot. Not much. A little.** **people** (ljudje) je množina: **How many people?** **money** (denar) in **time** (čas) ne šteješ: **How much time have we got?** (Koliko časa imamo?) Cena: **How much is the honey? — Four pounds.** (Koliko stane med? — Štiri funte.)
say.de: Kurze Antworten: **How many? — A lot. Not many. A few.** **How much? — A lot. Not much. A little.** **people** (Leute) ist Plural: **How many people?** **money** (Geld) und **time** (Zeit) zählt man nicht: **How much time have we got?** (Wie viel Zeit haben wir?) Der Preis: **How much is the honey? — Four pounds.** (Wie viel kostet der Honig? — Vier Pfund.)
say.it: Le risposte brevi: **How many? — A lot. Not many. A few.** **How much? — A lot. Not much. A little.** **people** (la gente) è plurale: **How many people?** **money** (denaro) e **time** (tempo) non si contano: **How much time have we got?** (Quanto tempo abbiamo?) Il prezzo: **How much is the honey? — Four pounds.** (Quanto costa il miele? — Quattro sterline.)
say.en: Short answers: **How many? — A lot. Not many. A few.** **How much? — A lot. Not much. A little.** **people** is a plural: **How many people?** You can't count **money** and **time**: **How much time have we got?** The price: **How much is the honey? — Four pounds.**

exercises.text: At the market Mrs Birkett talks to Arthur. — How ___ honey have you got today? — Not ___, only two jars. — How ___ is a jar? — Four pounds. — And how ___ eggs has Granny Maggie got? — Only a ___, about six. — There aren't ___ people here today. — No, but there's a ___ of cheese!

translation.sl: Na tržnici se gospa Birkett pogovarja z Arthurjem. — Koliko medu imaš danes? — Ne veliko, samo dva kozarca. — Koliko stane kozarec? — Štiri funte. — In koliko jajc ima babica Maggie? — Samo nekaj, kakih šest. — Danes tu ni veliko ljudi. — Ne, je pa veliko sira!
translation.de: Auf dem Markt spricht Frau Birkett mit Arthur. — Wie viel Honig hast du heute? — Nicht viel, nur zwei Gläser. — Wie viel kostet ein Glas? — Vier Pfund. — Und wie viele Eier hat Oma Maggie? — Nur ein paar, etwa sechs. — Heute sind nicht viele Leute hier. — Nein, aber es gibt viel Käse!
translation.it: Al mercato la signora Birkett parla con Arthur. — Quanto miele hai oggi? — Non molto, solo due vasetti. — Quanto costa un vasetto? — Quattro sterline. — E quante uova ha nonna Maggie? — Solo qualcuna, circa sei. — Oggi qui non c'è molta gente. — No, ma c'è tanto formaggio!
translation.en: At the market Mrs Birkett talks to Arthur. — How much honey have you got today? — Not much, only two jars. — How much is a jar? — Four pounds. — And how many eggs has Granny Maggie got? — Only a few, about six. — There aren't many people here today. — No, but there's a lot of cheese!
